MirrorMarsh_Text_Npc0.en: Stand still. The sky will fall in\nthe water.
MirrorMarsh_Text_Npc0.fr: Reste immobile. Le ciel tombera\ndans l'eau.

MirrorMarsh_Text_Npc1.en: I saw myself wave. I did not wave.
MirrorMarsh_Text_Npc1.fr: Je me suis vu faire un signe. J'ai\npas fait de signe.

MirrorMarsh_Text_ReturnAsk.en: Ready to go back to the dock?

MirrorMarsh_Text_Stay.en: Take your time. The tide can wait.
